Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner improperly prioritized an IMDb search snippet showing “1904” over two authoritative, corroborated sources (Britannica and Wikipedia) that listed 1901. It introduced an unjustified “industry-source precedence” rule and relied on a snippet rather than verifying the actual IMDb profile, failing to reconcile conflicting data. This misprioritization led to the incorrect conclusion that the actress (Marlene Dietrich) was born in 1904 instead of the widely accepted 1901.
